id: Dr. Panca Hadi Putra adalah associate professor di Fakultas Ilmu Komputer Universitas Indonesia. Ia meneliti sistem informasi, user experience, bisnis digital, dan informatika hukum. Di bidang informatika hukum, ia memimpin Lexin, tempat peneliti lintas disiplin mengembangkan platform teknologi hukum.

Di UI ia mengajar di program Magister Teknologi Informasi Fasilkom dan Magister Manajemen FEB, antara lain mata kuliah Analisis dan Perancangan Sistem, Metodologi Penelitian, Manajemen Strategis Sistem Informasi, Technology Entrepreneurship, dan Business Analytics. Di luar UI ia mengajar mata kuliah hukum terkait TI di program Magister Kenotariatan.

Sebelum menjadi akademisi, ia berwirausaha dan menjadi konsultan bagi berbagai merek: perusahaan Fortune 500 seperti PT Sony Indonesia dan PT Tupperware Indonesia, pemimpin kategori seperti PT Kalbe Nutritionals, PT Darya Varia Tbk., dan Del Monte Indonesia, hingga organisasi nirlaba seperti British Council dan Yayasan Sayap Ibu.
en: Dr. Panca Hadi Putra is an associate professor at the Faculty of Computer Science, Universitas Indonesia. His research interests are information systems, user experience, digital business and legal informatics. For legal informatics, he leads Lexin, where multidisciplinary researchers develop legal technology platforms.

At UI he teaches in the Master of Information Technology program at Fasilkom and the Master of Management program at the Faculty of Economics and Business, including Systems Analysis and Design, Research Methodology, Strategic Information Systems Management, Technology Entrepreneurship and Business Analytics. Outside UI, he teaches IT-related law courses in Master of Notarial Law programs.

Before academia, he was an entrepreneur and consultant for brands ranging from Fortune 500 companies such as PT Sony Indonesia and PT Tupperware Indonesia, category leaders such as PT Kalbe Nutritionals, PT Darya Varia Tbk. and Del Monte Indonesia, to non-profits such as the British Council and the Sayap Ibu Foundation.

text.id: Hukum Indonesia tersebar di puluhan situs pemerintah dan sulit ditelusuri. Klaussa menyatukannya dalam satu platform riset hukum berbasis AI dengan sitasi langsung ke pasal dan dokumen sumber, sehingga setiap jawaban bisa diverifikasi. Evans membangun platform ini (FastAPI dan React) pada sisi AI, retrieval, dan reliability produksi: multi-agent research assistant dengan loop planner-supervisor-executor, 15 tool, dan pipeline 7 fase; hybrid legal retrieval di atas 300 ribu+ regulasi (BM25, dense vector, HyDE, fusi RRF, cross-encoder reranking) yang unggul di 27 dari 40 evaluasi buta; production hardening (validasi JWT, login lockout, rotasi multi-key Gemini dengan failover); dan release safety dengan 2.200+ tes otomatis, contract-drift check OpenAPI, vulnerability scan Trivy, dan auto-rollback. Platform ini mengindeks 3,1 juta+ pasal dan 319 ribu+ dokumen hukum, menjawab 6.900+ pertanyaan hukum, menganalisis 1.250+ dokumen, dan menghemat 8.000+ jam kerja pengguna, serta dipakai tim hukum, advokat, mahasiswa, dan klien B2B.
text.en: Indonesian law is spread across dozens of government sites and hard to trace. Klaussa brings it together in one AI legal research platform with citations straight to the article and source document, so every answer can be verified. Evans built this platform (FastAPI and React) on the AI, retrieval and production reliability side: a multi-agent research assistant with a planner-supervisor-executor loop, 15 tools and a 7-phase pipeline; hybrid legal retrieval over 300k+ regulations (BM25, dense vector, HyDE, RRF fusion, cross-encoder reranking) that wins 27 of 40 blind evaluations; production hardening (JWT validation, login lockout, multi-key Gemini rotation with failover); and release safety with 2,200+ automated tests, OpenAPI contract-drift checks, Trivy vulnerability scans and auto-rollback. The platform indexes 3.1 million+ articles and 319 thousand+ legal documents, has answered 6,900+ legal questions, analyzed 1,250+ documents and saved 8,000+ hours of user work, and is used by legal teams, advocates, students and B2B clients.

text.id: Masalah: skema akun APBN dan APBD tidak kompatibel, sehingga analisis belanja publik lintas sistem lambat dan mahal. Hasil: merekonsiliasi 1,83 juta record anggaran (setara sekitar USD 224,4 miliar belanja publik), waktu analisis turun dari 5 hari menjadi 20 menit, biaya per analisis turun dari sekitar USD 28 ribu menjadi sekitar USD 50, dan di-deploy di AWS Region Jakarta untuk memenuhi ketentuan residensi data.
text.en: Problem: APBN and APBD account schemes are incompatible, so cross-system public spending analysis is slow and expensive. Result: reconciled 1.83 million budget records (about USD 224.4 billion of public spending), cut analysis time from 5 days to 20 minutes, cut cost per analysis from about USD 28 thousand to about USD 50, and deployed on AWS Region Jakarta to meet data residency rules.

text.id: Masalah: hukum Indonesia tersebar di 37 situs pemerintah dan sulit ditelusuri. Hasil: 297 ribu regulasi diakuisisi dan diindeks menjadi sekitar 3,48 juta vektor, 2,57 juta relasi sitasi dipetakan dengan presisi sekitar 99%, OCR mandiri di klaster 16 GPU RTX 5090 menghemat sekitar 92% biaya OCR, dan melayani sekitar 100 pengguna aktif harian di produksi.
text.en: Problem: Indonesian law is spread across 37 government sites and hard to trace. Result: 297 thousand regulations acquired and indexed into about 3.48 million vectors, 2.57 million citation relations mapped at about 99% precision, self-hosted OCR on a 16-GPU RTX 5090 cluster saving about 92% of OCR cost, and serving about 100 daily active users in production.
